en: A vintage, hand-tinted postcard depicting a large church with a tall central tower and spire, surrounded by lush trees. Another distinct church tower is visible in the background. Much of the card is adorned with handwritten notes and greetings, mostly in Old German or Estonian. The lower part of the image mentions 'REVAL' and 'Johanniskirche', while the side margin says 'Hermann Seibt, Reval'.
